params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: What Gentells reads from Belgium rests on one broadcaster and holds no French-language source, so a Belgian or Flemish reading has too little under it. More Belgian sources are needed, in both languages and closer to young people.

Source: Portal mail:62. Follows from the question in Trendwolves/gentells-standard#25.

## What is thin

Counted on 19 November 2026 from the Observatory's intake mix per source, over 90 days, by where the source is at home:

| | In | Kept | Cited |
|---|---|---|---|
| Belgian sources | 9,174 | 1,351 | 47 |
| Share of all intake | 3.2% | 2.6% | 1.4% |

- VRT NWS brings 6,957 of the 9,174 (76%). Knack brings 1,575, FashionUnited BE 484, the Belgian charts (Shazam, App Store, Apple Music) 143 together.
- Every Belgian source is Dutch-language. French-speaking Belgium is not read at all.
- The Belgian sources are general news and trade press. Music, culture, gaming and lifestyle titles that young people in Belgium read are missing.
- The source lists of 20 October, 9 November and 15 November hold 103 Belgian rows, mostly organisations, surveys and trade press; three are French-language, all trade press.

## What is asked

1. A source list of Belgian titles with a live feed that the earlier lists do not hold: Flemish news, music, culture, gaming and lifestyle, and the French-language counterparts (public broadcaster, dailies, weeklies, culture and youth media). They come in as proposals, like every list.
2. A trial for them, started by a person, and a look at the scorecard after two weeks: which earn their place.
3. Left for later, named so it is not lost: Belgian titles without a feed (student papers, youth newsrooms), which need a page reader or a newsletter inbox, and observed Belgian signals from platforms, which press cannot replace.
params.title: Read more Belgian sources: Flemish youth and culture titles, and French-language Belgium
